'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Winston Plunkett DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Winston Plunkett]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: JUND. Transcription note: Additional Cards #1 lists Hyperoute Navigation Chart (61st card?)

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe]]
* '''Username:''' winston p
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
